description: This file defines the GatewayConnectConfig struct, which encapsulates configuration details for establishing connections to a gateway, including URL, tokens, TLS parameters, and connection options. It also provides a computed property for a stable identifier used for persistence.

classes.name: GatewayConnectConfig
classes.description: A struct representing the configuration parameters for connecting to a gateway, including URL, tokens, TLS options, and node-specific options.

methods.name: effectiveStableID
methods.description: Computes a stable, non-empty identifier used for gateway-scoped persistence keys, defaulting to the URL string if 'stableID' is empty or whitespace.
